task.description:
WF-04 Step 4 — Frontend Unit Tests. Run all frontend unit tests.

1. Run `cd web && npm run test` to run all frontend unit tests.
2. Classify failures as BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR.
3. Write results to tests/reports/WF04-full-20260523-step04-frontend-tests.md

Note: If no frontend tests exist (as discovered in Step 2), report PASS with note that no tests are defined yet. This is acceptable for now.
acceptance_criteria: All existing frontend tests pass (or no tests exist)

result.summary: Frontend unit tests: no test files found. vitest reports 'No test files found' — no *.test.ts or *.spec.ts files exist under web/src/ or web/tests/. This is acceptable for the current project stage. Test infrastructure (vitest, @testing-library/jest-dom) is installed and configured.
result.next_action: Route to step-05-e2e (TEST-RUNNER for E2E tests) or RELEASE-VALIDATOR
